verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents several latency features: streaming, SDK TCP warming to cut TTFT, msgpack/gzip payload optimization to improve TTFT, Predicted Outputs, a highest-priority service tier for time-critical requests, and dedicated reserved-capacity endpoints with latency metrics. Many independent hands-on reports describe extremely fast generation, including ~300 tok/s and real-time voice apps. One user reports hitting the shared tier's request-per-minute limit instantly, a friction for sustained throughput rather than a contradiction of speed. Missing for 10: first-party quantitative TTFT and tokens/sec figures, and evidence that sustained high throughput holds on shared tiers without immediately hitting rate limits.
